qualification: local pinned-fixture correctness and bounded performance evidence; not hardware, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

source.runnerBuildEquivalence: The amended implementation commit changes only the measured-address test fixture; production sources are identical to the runner build commit.

admission.operation: long-mode qword PUSH from a scalar memory source
admission.callbacks: restartable scalar read followed by transactional scalar write
admission.ordering: the source is read through the old register image before RSP is decremented, including RSP-relative and source/destination-aliasing forms
admission.deferred: non-qword memory PUSH IR, memory SETcc, and memory read-modify-write forms

verification.dbtAndPCGate: 1,435 tests in 171 suites passed; one pinned PVH environment test skipped because its environment variables were absent
verification.differentialCoverage: Ordinary base-plus-displacement, old-RSP-relative, and source/destination-aliasing PUSH forms match the interpreter in architectural state and memory.
verification.rollbackCoverage: A failed source read and a failed destination write after a successful read both preserve the original architectural state and memory.
verification.negativeAdmissionCoverage: A direct non-qword memory PUSH IR fixture remains a tier-one decline.

boundedAB.purpose: Separate candidate cost from the unmatched full-run wall-time swing.
boundedAB.expectedOutcome: instruction-budget before userspace; timing evidence only
boundedAB.interpretation: The balanced bounded comparison shows no measurable regression and a small directional improvement; it is not a statistical performance claim.

unmatchedFullRunComparison.interpretation: The single sequential full runs differ in dynamic instruction and interrupt totals and are not a matched performance comparison. The balanced fixed-instruction A/B is the retained directional measurement.

interpretation: The bounded qword memory-PUSH slice removes the three selected measured native-emitter declines, preserves restartability across both callbacks, passes a complete userspace workload run, and does not regress the balanced fixed-instruction comparison. A05.2 remains open because 130,204 of 229,174 full-run tier-one attempts still declined.
limitations: All trials ran on one local Apple M2 Pro and do not establish cross-host or hardware behavior.
The six bounded trials stop at the instruction budget before userspace and support only a directional candidate-cost comparison.
The complete workload evidence contains one candidate run; its elapsed time must not be compared statistically with an earlier single run.
The diagnostic runner marks every record releaseQualified=false; this evidence does not satisfy G1-G5.
